_documentation.purpose: Structural EXAMPLE of the shared <archive-root>/pipeline_manifest.json consumed by scripts/train_full_dataset.py plan --manifest (cross-check only), scripts/archive_dataset_results.py (requires this file at <archive-root>/pipeline_manifest.json), and scripts/evaluate_dataset.py / scripts/run_eval_queue.sh (--manifest / EVAL_MANIFEST).
_documentation.how_to_use: Copy this file to your deployment archive root as pipeline_manifest.json and replace every value marked below as user-editable. Do NOT rename the contract keys; the workers read them verbatim.
user_editable_paths: local_project: absolute path of this repository checkout
local_python: python interpreter of the local evaluation environment (scripts/run_eval_queue.sh default is env var EVAL_PYTHON)
archive_root: local directory holding <scene>/<stage>/ archives, evaluation/ results, and this pipeline_manifest.json
local_dataset_root: local copy of datasets_JAX/ and datasets_NYC/
local_eval_archive_root: local directory for official eval data (results_eval)

remote_host / remote_read_host: SSH CONFIG ALIASES defined in ~/.ssh/config. They are names, not hostnames; no credentials belong in this file. archive_dataset_results.py --host defaults to remote_host.
remote_project / remote_run_root / remote_control_root / remote_activation: absolute paths inside the remote training host
_documentation.scenes: Keep the 12-scene list and order; scripts/train_full_dataset.py plan --manifest cross-checks it against the embedded table. The training runner's authoritative scene table and reuse paths are EMBEDDED in scripts/train_full_dataset.py (SCENES), not derived from this manifest. The archive worker DOES consume the manifest reuse_stage1/reuse_stage2 values as source/provenance paths; customize them to the same verified remote snapshots configured in the training runner.
recipe_decisions_that_are_not_defaults_t: JAX uses the 3x3 IDU grid (jax_v1); NYC keeps its 4x4 grid and scene-family loss settings (nyc_v1).
Stage 1 runs 30000 iterations; Stage 2 runs five 10000-iteration episodes; final_iteration is 80000.
Retention requires BOTH the final checkpoint (learned appearance embeddings/MLP) AND the matching point_cloud PLY (filter_3D); neither alone is a faithful model.
_documentation.not_turnkey: Copying this example does NOT by itself make a fresh deployment turnkey: scripts/train_full_dataset.py is a frozen experiment queue whose scene table, recipes and root defaults target the 2026-09-13 experiment. Set roots via GZ_RUN_ROOT/GZ_CONTROL_ROOT/GZ_ARCHIVE_ROOT or CLI overrides, cross-check with plan --manifest, and reconfigure embedded reuse paths before run. The run subcommand does not accept --manifest.
_documentation.outputs: Training publishes <remote_run_root>/<scene>/<stage>/stage_complete.json. Archiving publishes <archive_root>/<scene>/<stage>/archive_status.json (status=verified). Evaluation publishes <archive_root>/<scene>/evaluation/<stage>/evaluation_status.json (model_load_verified=true, then completed). Remote cleanup is gated on the verified archive AND the model-load-confirmed evaluation.

retention.model_archive_reason: The checkpoint contains learned per-Gaussian appearance embeddings and MLP; filter_3D is stored in the matching PLY, not capture(). Both are required for faithful evaluation with the existing model format.

stage_publish_contract.ready_marker_rule: Atomically publish completion markers last; no other worker edits another worker's status file.

evaluation.primary: All held-out satellite views, identical cameras and pixel-domain PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS for Stage1 and Stage2
evaluation.visual: Fixed checked-in camera trajectories, Stage1 versus Stage2 videos and comparison grids
evaluation.official_gt_rule: Verify current official availability and pose/frame correspondence. Never label unaligned frames as paired PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS ground truth. Report missing GT explicitly; do not omit any of the 12 training scenes.
evaluation.gpu_batch_policy: Sequential model loading and one-frame rendering on 24GB local GPU; no training optimizer GPU allocation.
